name: TC-11-blanket-contract-po
description: TC-11.3 & TC-11.4: Blanket & Contract Purchase Orders — Create POs with different types and verify type-specific fields

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.3 — Purchase Order List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Purchase Order. PO types include Standard (one-time), Blanket (spending limit), and Contract (date range).

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.3 — Purchase Order Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The purchase order list displays all POs with their type, vendor, status, and total amount. Filter by PO type to view specific categories.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.3 — New Blanket PO Form
doc_metadata.caption: Create a new purchase order. Select PO Type = 'Blanket' to create a blanket order with a spending limit. The Blanket Limit and Released Amount fields appear for this type.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.3 — Blanket PO Form Fields
doc_metadata.caption: The blanket PO form shows type-specific fields: Blanket Limit (maximum spending), Released Amount (amount already released), and vendor selection. These fields control spending authorization.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.3 — Blanket PO Created
doc_metadata.caption: The blanket purchase order is created in Draft state. Approve to make it active. Releases against this PO are tracked against the spending limit.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.3 — Blanket PO Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The blanket PO detail shows the spending limit, released amount, remaining balance, and associated release orders.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.4 — New Contract PO Form
doc_metadata.caption: Create another purchase order. Select PO Type = 'Contract' to create a contract-based order with start and end dates.

doc_metadata.title: TC-11.4 — Contract PO Form Fields
doc_metadata.caption: The contract PO form shows type-specific fields: Contract Start Date, Contract End Date, and terms. These control the validity period of the procurement agreement.
